column1: # The compressed float32 range corpus over Fends.schema beside this file
# (SPEC.md 4.6: a float32 field's declared range is compared at float32; a
# compressed -0 lands as +0). TestRubyCompressedFloatFloat32Ends reads every
# row, runs each on both pinned Ruby interpreters, and holds the answer to the
# form: variable (Probe#save then Probe.load), json (Probe#to_json then
#   message (save_messages of one Msg then load_messages after the
# value: the value set (a Ruby float), or for json-text the JSON number.
# expect: held <the value read back, as Ruby's Float#inspect spells it, so
#   0.0 is +0 and -0.0 is -0> or refused (the write or the read refuses;
#   which one, and the reason, are diagnostic detail).
